DATA:
- Box 1: "Notice required (60 days)" points via a right-facing arrow to a box containing:
  - 100 or more total employees
  - 50 or more employees laid off
- Box 2: "Exceptions" points via a right-facing arrow to a box containing:
  - Does not include part-time workers (<20 hours)
  - Does not include new workers (<6 months)

KEY FACTS:
- A 60-day advance notice is required under the WARN law.
- The notice requirement applies to employers with 100 or more total employees experiencing 50 or more layoffs.
- Exceptions to the employee count include part-time workers working fewer than 20 hours.
- Exceptions also include new workers who have been employed for less than 6 months.
